turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here? Owen's essay got a zero, and nobody called me first.
I'm a second-year teacher. Nobody trained me for meetings like this.
Then you'll want to start with why Owen found out from his phone. Who decided on the zero?
Could you coach me a little? How should I open a conversation like this next time?
I'm not here to coach you. Who decided on the zero, and why wasn't I called first?
